race.comment: MISS YOU TOO (6) looks close to another win after finishing second last time (19.57) in a Grade 6 at this track. Won at her only start from this box. Well placed and gets her chance. WHERE'S WAL (1) put in a much better performance last start when in the placings at Capalaba behind Hello Gemini (20.28) in a Grade 6. Got back and turned spotting a start but found the line impressively. Hard to beat again. SPRING ARROW (2) turned in a plain effort last time when eighth at Q Lakeside over 390m behind Tick Girl (22.94) in a Grade 6. Placed at his previous run. Deserves plenty of respect. RACEVIEW ROCKET (8) is a last-start placegetter with solid claims again.
